title: cruster changed (NDJSON record)
description: What shifted in a namespace recently. Per-change records sorted most-recent-first, then one terminal `summary` record with counts and `kinds_absent` (negative-evidence field). v1 scope: secret_rotated, configmap_changed, replicaset_rolled, image_changed, resource_created (workloads + services).

before.description: Prior-state fields. For `image_changed`: { image?, rs, revision? }. Null for kinds without history (secret_rotated, configmap_changed, resource_created).

after.description: New-state fields. For `image_changed`: { image?, rs, revision? }. For `secret_rotated`/`configmap_changed`: { resource_version }. Null for kinds without an `after` payload.

attrs.description: Kind-specific. `secret_rotated`/`configmap_changed`: { manager?, consumed_by[] }. `replicaset_rolled`: { owner, revision? }. `image_changed`: { container }.

kinds_absent.description: Kinds that produced zero records in this window. The calling agent should not re-check these.

managed_fields_history.description: Always true in v1: kube does not preserve prior Secret/ConfigMap resourceVersion, so rotation records carry only the current `after.resource_version`.
